verdict.rationale: Antigravity's settings document a Telemetry toggle that lets users enable or disable sharing interaction logs used to improve models, which is a first-party opt-out from model-training data sharing. The evidence is a single thin settings line and does not say whether code and prompts are explicitly covered. missing for 10: explicit statement that code and prompts are excluded from training when disabled, an org/admin-level enforced opt-out for an engineering lead, data-use/retention policy documentation, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can opt out of having my code and prompts used for AI model training

citations.quote: toggle Telemetry (enable/disable sharing interaction logs to improve models)
